_comment: First-game tips. Each shows once per game, at most one a turn, the first in this list whose 'when' holds (see scripts/sim/tips.gd for the conditions). Settings can turn tips off.

tips.text: Welcome! First, build a Shaft next to the Landing Pad: homes, food and air all go in the Deep, under the surface.
You still have no Shaft. Homes, food and air can only be built in the Deep, so build one next to the colony soon.
The Deep is open! Press Deep (or E) and build a Splitter (air), a Kelp Vat or Mushroom Farm (food) and a Bunkhouse (homes) around the landing.
Oxygen will run out in a few turns. Build a Splitter in the Deep; it turns water into air, so it needs an Ice Drill too.
Food is running low. Build a Kelp Vat (lots of food, needs heat) or a Mushroom Farm (less food, needs very little heat) in the Deep.
Water is running low. Build an Ice Drill on ice (pale blue ground), or on underground water in the Deep.
Some buildings are idle for lack of power. Build Solar Arrays: they make more toward the sunny side of the map.
Some buildings are idle for lack of heat. Build a Vent Tap on an orange vent: it gives lots of steady heat.
The colony is crowded: people get sick and unhappy. Build another Bunkhouse in the Deep.
A Company payment is due soon. To make money: a Seam Cutter digs ore, a Forge turns it into alloy, and a Spin Launcher sells the alloy.
Lots of people have no work. Put them to use: build more, or a Survey Lab to start research.
A grit storm is cutting your solar power. Battery Banks save spare power for times like this, and Sweeper rovers keep the panels clean.
Morale is low, so everyone works slower. A Commons, Lounge, Garden Cavern or Radio Station cheers people up.
Tip: the Colony report (next to End turn) shows where your power, heat and workers go, and why any building is idle.
